explanation: Green Problem 91 'Update 2021': Ferber, Kwan, Narayanan, Sah and Sawhney showed the 99% question has a positive answer; their Theorem 1.1 (arXiv:2105.13337) gives, with high probability, a bisection of G(n,1/2) in which n − o(n) vertices are friendly. The Lean statement: ∃ f = o(n) such that P(∃ s, |s| = ⌊n/2⌋, numFriendly G s ≥ n − f(n)) → 1. This is the standard formalisation of 'whp n − o(n)' (a single deterministic o(n) function), and it implies green_91. Faithful.
